item.title: About
item.description:
I am Fredrik Rundgren, a data and analytics leader with a background in data engineering, operations, and architecture. I currently lead Redpill Linpro Data Analytics Stockholm.

I have spent much of my career at the point where technical design meets the reality of operating a service. A data platform can look convincing in a diagram and still fail the people who depend on it. Clear ownership, trustworthy inputs, observable behavior, and the ability to improve a system without losing control matter as much as the initial build.

item.title: CV
item.description:
Profile

I am CEO and Partner of Redpill Linpro Data Analytics Stockholm AB. My work spans data engineering, platform architecture, information modelling, service operations, and consulting leadership. I help organisations turn data ambitions into dependable capabilities: systems that people can understand, operate, and improve.

My approach combines technical depth with clear ownership and practical delivery. I have moved from hands-on development and database work into leading teams and services, while staying close to the architecture and engineering decisions that shape long-term outcomes.
